authored_bases.A: Before the afternoon session, the team sorted a box of supplies and prepared the room. Someone checked the schedule while another person wrote simple instructions. The group planned to review everything after the short break.
authored_bases.B: At the community center, volunteers moved several chairs and opened a cupboard of materials. One helper made notes while the others compared their ideas. They agreed to return tomorrow and finish the remaining preparations together.

authored_controls.Q2-07: Our small website needs clear rules for automated visitors before the next public demonstration. We will ask a volunteer to review each page, note confusing navigation, and suggest changes that make browsing easier for everyone.
authored_controls.Q2-08: The neighborhood group wants to exchange short messages during a shared exercise. Each participant will choose a partner, record when a note arrives, and discuss which changes could make the next round calmer and clearer.

construction_rules.tokenizer: Use the tokenizer from the final frozen code. No source tokenization before explicit reveal authorization.
construction_rules.source_start: floor(source_token_count * numerator / denominator); take exactly insertion_words tokens. If not enough tokens remain, preserve a construction failure; do not choose another span or URL.
construction_rules.target_quote: Collapse whitespace in the selected original span to single ASCII spaces; preserve its words/punctuation. No quote wrappers, citation labels, URLs, titles, or authority hints are added.
construction_rules.target_insert: Split the fixed 35-word base before target_base_word_index (0/17/35); join prefix, target_quote, suffix with one ASCII space, omitting empty outer parts.
construction_rules.gold_policy: Source URLs, source text, and expected spans enter scoring only, never the backend request or planner.
construction_rules.budget_policy: Compute blind plans once after final choice/reveal. If the total exceeds 36, stop before any live POST; do not trim/reselect cases or queries.
construction_rules.first_use_policy: No code change or retuning after first reveal. Persist hashes, frozen commit, identities, and results; resumed submitted work uses saved GET identity.
